name: parallel-root
description: Drive an Android phone as an agent, without root. Read its state through structured queries, act through intents, and fall to the screen only when nothing above it will do. Several agents can work at once, each on a trusted virtual display of its own that the person holding the phone never sees. Ships two skills: phone, the method, with a dated map of a reference device; and screens, for more than one agent on one phone.
